lessons.title: Thirty Minutes in the Maker Room
lessons.goal: 讀懂預約、截止時間與最後使用時段。
lessons.story:
MAKER ROOM BOOKING

The maker room opens from 3:00 to 5:00 p.m. on weekdays. Each team may book one thirty-minute slot per day. Available starting times are 3:00, 3:30, 4:00, and 4:30. Cleaning is included in your slot, so leave the tables ready for the next team.

Book by noon on the day before your visit. For a Monday visit, book by noon on Friday. A booking is complete only after you receive a confirmation message. Writing your name on a waiting list does not reserve a place.

If you arrive more than ten minutes late, the room manager may give your slot to a waiting team. Arriving late never moves the ending time. Bring your design on paper because the room computers are not available for drawing plans. You may use them only to control the machines.

words.example: A waiting list does not reserve a place.
The computers are available for machine control.

questions.prompt: How long is one team’s slot?
options: Thirty minutes, with extra cleaning time afterward.
questions.explanation: 每組三十分鐘，清潔已包含在內。
questions.evidence: Cleaning is included in your slot, so leave the tables ready for the next team.
reasons: 不能额外占用下一組時間。
兩小時是全日開放長度。

questions.explanation: 收到確認訊息後預約才成立。
questions.evidence: A booking is complete only after you receive a confirmation message.
reasons: only after 明確列必要條件。
公告說候補不保留名額。
備好圖紙不等於訂成功。

questions.prompt: When must a team book a Monday visit?
questions.explanation: 星期一使用的特別規則是週五中午前，不能套用一般前一天。
questions.evidence: For a Monday visit, book by noon on Friday.

questions.prompt: What does “slot” mean in the notice?
options: A period set aside for a team.
A narrow hole in a machine.
questions.explanation: 與開始時間及三十分鐘連用，slot 指預約時段。
questions.evidence: Each team may book one thirty-minute slot per day.

questions.prompt: A team keeps its 4:00 slot but arrives at 4:08. When must it finish cleaning and leave?
questions.explanation: 遲到不順延結束時間，4:00開始的30分時段仍4:30結束。
questions.evidence: Arriving late never moves the ending time.

questions.prompt: Which action is allowed by the notice?
options: Keep working after a slot ends if the team arrived late.
Book two slots for the same team on one day.
Bring a paper design and use a room computer to control a machine.
Use a room computer to draw the plan from the beginning.
questions.explanation: 電腦限機器控制，圖稿需事先用紙帶來；其餘均違規。
questions.evidence: You may use them only to control the machines.
reasons: 符合紙圖與機器控制用途。
